messages.content: Read the recent exchange. Is it advancing meaningfully or appropriately finished, or returning to essentially the same unsolved ground? Output one digit only: 0 = advancing or appropriately finished; 1 = cannot tell from the evidence; 2 = unresolved circling.

It allows non-artists to contribute and makes success more concrete."}, {"participant": "We still have not tested either. Can you compare a third approach?", "gemma": "An individual search-and-find sheet avoids shared materials and coordination, but offers less group interaction."}, {"participant": "All the original constraints still apply.
